# Vendored adblock-lean

Source: https://github.com/lynxthecat/adblock-lean  
License: **GNU General Public License v2.0** (`GPL-2.0`) — see upstream [`LICENCE.md`](https://github.com/lynxthecat/adblock-lean/blob/master/LICENCE.md).

LeanDNS vendors these OpenWrt service scripts so the appliance can enable ad blocking without a separate online install. Their license terms remain those of the upstream project; LeanDNS does not relicense them.

Files:
- `etc/init.d/adblock-lean`
- `usr/lib/adblock-lean/abl-lib.sh`
- `usr/lib/adblock-lean/abl-process.sh`

Refresh with `scripts/sync-adblock-lean.sh`.
